breaking.change: og.Fluid2D steps with the solver og.Fluid3D uses: neighbours come from the spatial hash in its pair order, a particle pushed out of a solid loses its velocity into it and a little of its slide (as in 3D), and its spawn jitter differs. A 2D fluid settles to the same shape but not to the same particle positions, so the world hash of a world with one, and a snapshot or replay recorded on an earlier version, no longer match.
breaking.fix: Re-record replays and pinned hashes of worlds with an og.Fluid2D; restore no snapshot holding one across the version. No field changed.
